review.method: Pinned bytes, ZIP/XML cached cells, source header checks, row-count and identity audit.

sourcePolicy.cutoffMeaning: Analyst-selected voltage cutoff, not an alarm threshold.
sourcePolicy.denominator: Percentages use only finite selected-channel readings among the selected rows.
sourcePolicy.rowMeaning: Source records include repeated aging readings and shared specimens, apparatus and calibration; they are not independent trials.
sourcePolicy.zeroMeaning: A finite cached zero stays zero; it does not establish an enabled sensor, zero smoke, or nondetection.
sourcePolicy.missingMeaning: Blank, error and non-numeric source values are retained and excluded from the finite denominator; no gap filling.
sourcePolicy.channelMeaning: All selectable channels are volts. Obscuration volts are not percent obscuration; ion delta is not a detector alarm.
sourcePolicy.filterMeaning: Flight and material selection does not validate instrument operation. Recorded use/quality fields remain attached to rows.
sourcePolicy.sourceScope: Material Sort flight markers 1/2 only; ground records and other worksheets are not silently pooled.
sourcePolicy.referenceMeaning: DBP is a reference material and is excluded by the default selection; 20 rows are available explicitly.

identityConflicts.statement: The 109-row SAME-R condition table and 109 flight-2 workbook records have different material/test identities. No automatic crosswalk, correction, deletion or row filling is applied.

method.tiePolicy: Exact equality of admitted cached numbers; tied observations receive average ranks. No rounding, tie-breaking jitter or epsilon.
method.pairing: Exact workbook hash, sheet and Excel row; sample labels group deletions only and never join observations.
method.deletionMeaning: Delete every selected row with one exact recorded (flight, sampleId) label, then rerank the retained finite pairs. The minimum/maximum are a finite sensitivity range, not a confidence interval or independence correction. Unknown labels block this operation within that stratum.

references.title: SciPy: Spearman rank-order correlation; constant inputs are undefined

flags.message: Rank association describes co-ordering of recorded channels, not agreement, calibration, causality, alarms, superiority or prediction.
Association uses only jointly finite same-row pairs. No values are imputed and no bound for missing readings is claimed.
Flight 2 has positive and negative material-stratum rank associations. A pooled coefficient does not describe every material. These are descriptive signs, not significance findings.

instrumentNotes: Both channels are stored volts but have different measurement operators. Association does not require or establish equivalent physical response.
Zeros and negative values remain finite; they do not establish sensor operation. Recorded use, fan and flat-profile cells remain available in every source row.
A recorded sample label is a deletion block, not a verified independent experiment. Aging, reused samples, apparatus and calibration can create additional dependence.
The workbook/condition-table identity conflict is retained. No cross-source identity join or correction is performed.
The three-pair minimum is a display policy, not sufficient sample size for inference. Constant inputs return null; no missing-data association interval is claimed.

Ranks ignore amplitude: inspect both paired voltage ranges. Stable signs under group deletion do not establish robustness to measurement error or rounding; instrument resolution, noise and saturation thresholds are not established here.
result.reviewStatement: Assistant-checked source transcription and descriptive rank computation. Not independent scientific validation, a fitted physical model, an alarm evaluation or a confidence estimate.
